## Description

For each program file in `generated/programs-list.txt` (from [04_list_program_files.sh](#help-04_list_program_files)), counts Windows-style paths (backslashes), drive letters (`C:\`), Unix-style paths, and files that mix both. Files under `ado/` and `.ado` files are skipped. Backslash paths and drive letters prevent code from running on Linux and macOS.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/07_check_file_paths.sh <directory> [tag]
```

- `directory` - Deposit directory the listed paths are relative to.
- `tag` - Optional suffix for the output names. The input list is always the untagged `generated/programs-list.txt`.

## Outputs

- `generated/file-paths-report[.tag].csv` - Counts per file
- `generated/file-paths-report[.tag].md` - The same as a Markdown table
- `generated/file-paths-summary[.tag].md` - Totals and a warning when problems were found
